_about: Lab (research, docs/research/dynamic-decals.md), part 2 of 2: run with Send-Suite -Fresh after lab-dyn-decals.json. Loads the city saved with code-made decals on it in a game that has never made them (what a player meets after removing the mod: nothing in the save names them). Records lab decals alive, prefabs named like ours, obsolete prefabs and objects on a missing prefab, and takes the same view; the save is deleted at the end. Send with: powershell -File tools/suite/Send-Suite.ps1 -File suite/scenarios/lab-dyn-decals-load.json -Fresh -Who decal-engine
